# proxmox_sdn_subnet (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox VE SDN subnet through `/cluster/sdn/vnets/{vnet}/subnets`. Subnets stage like zones and VNets and only take effect when `proxmox_sdn_apply` commits. The parent VNet must be `vlanaware = false`. Requires `SDN.Allocate` on the VNet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Subnets belong to a VNet and only take effect after proxmox_sdn_apply.
# The parent VNet must not be `vlanaware`.
# Credentials need SDN.Allocate on the parent VNet.

resource "proxmox_sdn_subnet" "app" {
  vnet    = proxmox_sdn_vnet.vlan100.vnet
  cidr    = "10.100.0.0/24"
  gateway = "10.100.0.1"
  snat    = true

  dhcp_range = [
    {
      start_address = "10.100.0.10"
      end_address   = "10.100.0.50"
    },
  ]
}

# IPv6 subnet with a DNS zone prefix instead of DHCP.
resource "proxmox_sdn_subnet" "app_v6" {
  vnet          = proxmox_sdn_vnet.vlan100.vnet
  cidr          = "fd00:100::/64"
  dnszoneprefix = "app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) Subnet in CIDR form, for example `10.1.0.0/24`. Changes require replacement.
- `vnet` (String) Parent VNet. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `dhcp_dns_server` (String) DNS server announced to DHCP clients.
- `dhcp_range` (Attributes List) DHCP address ranges inside the subnet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dhcp_range))
- `dnszoneprefix` (String) DNS zone prefix, for example `adm` yields `<host>.adm.<dnszone>`.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway address inside the subnet. Proxmox assigns it to the VNet for layer-3 zones.
- `snat` (Boolean) Masquerade traffic from this subnet when the Proxmox firewall is active.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal Proxmox subnet id (`<zone>-<network>-<mask>`).
- `pending` (Map of String) Properties Proxmox currently reports as staged but not committed, with `deleted` for removals.
- `state` (String) Proxmox staging state: `new` or `changed` while the subnet is not committed yet.
- `zone` (String) Zone of the parent VNet, as reported by Proxmox.

<a id="nestedatt--dhcp_range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dhcp_range`

Required:

- `end_address` (String) Last address of the range.
- `start_address` (String) First address of the range.
